name: Difference
sharedIdea: two things that do not match.

notes.差: the gap between what ought to have matched — a shortfall, an error
notes.异: other than the rest — strange, foreign, dissenting
notes.别: parted off from — and hence "don't", and "another"
notes.区: marked off into zones — the difference of boundary
notes.分: cut into parts — the difference of division
notes.殊: set apart as special — difference of kind, not degree

compounds.gloss: is measured difference, 差别 is

notes.取: you reached for it — the active take
notes.受: it came to you — the passive take
notes.收: taken in and put away — gathering, storing
notes.获: taken as a yield — what the effort returned
notes.采: picked out, the good ones chosen
notes.盗: taken by stealth, the robber's take

notes.尊: honoured as senior — the vertical of rank
notes.奉: offered up with both hands — respect enacted
notes.钦: admired by a superior looking down

compounds.gloss: to hold up as a model

name: The rule
sharedIdea: the standard you are measured against.

notes.法: the law, and the method that follows from it
notes.规: the compass — the rule that draws a circle
notes.律: the fixed rule, unbending — hence music's 音律
notes.矩: the set square — the rule that draws a right angle
notes.则: the norm, and so the "then" that follows from it
notes.章: the section, and the seal that stamps it

compounds.gloss: is the pair that repays knowing: compass plus set square, the two tools that

notes.聚: drawn into a mass — the crowd thickens
notes.集: gathered into one place — the collection
notes.会: coming together to meet — hence the meeting, and "can"
notes.合: closed together into one — the joining, the fit
notes.团: rolled into a ball — the body, the regiment

notes.持: held up and maintained — sustained by effort
notes.留: kept back in place — remaining, detaining

notes.回: turned round and back — the circle closes
notes.报: word sent back — report, and requital
notes.复: done over again, and so returned

compounds.gloss: and 报复 share a character and split on the other: repay a kindness, repay an injury.

name: The thread running through
sharedIdea: a strand that runs through and organises.

notes.经: the warp — the lengthways thread, hence the classic text, hence passing through
notes.络: the net of strands — the web
notes.纬: the weft — the crossways thread, hence latitude
notes.理: the grain in jade — the pattern you follow, hence reason

compounds.gloss: is worth dwelling on: the one who runs the warp and the grain — who keeps the

notes.终: the end reached, the finish of a process
notes.末: the far tip — the last of it, the tail
notes.尽: used to the very limit — exhausted
notes.端: the end held level — and so upright, proper

notes.充: filled out to full, hence standing in for
notes.填: filled in — a hole, a form
notes.补: the missing part filled — mending, supplement
notes.饱: filled to capacity — of the belly

name: Through and out
sharedIdea: an opening, and what passes through it.

notes.洞: a hole right through — the cave
notes.穿: passing right through — hence putting clothes on
notes.泄: let out through a gap — discharge, divulge

name: Hand and hold
sharedIdea: the hand, and what it does.

notes.手: the hand itself, and the one who works with it
notes.掌: the flat of the palm — and so control in it
notes.提: carried hanging from the hand — hence raised, hence raised as a topic
notes.控: held in hand and directed — hence to charge, accuse

notes.微: small to the point of faint

notes.位: the position you occupy — seat, rank
notes.处: the place you are situated, and dealing with it
notes.所: the place, and the marker of what a verb acts on
notes.场: the open ground set for something to happen
notes.址: the ground a thing stands on — site, address

notes.气: air and breath, and the temper carried on it
notes.息: the breath, and the rest that follows — hence interest accruing

compounds.gloss: to breathe pairs the two directions.

name: Carrying
sharedIdea: a load taken up and moved.

notes.载: loaded onto — and so recorded, set down
notes.运: carried along — transport, and the fortune that carries you
notes.负: carried on the back — and so borne as a loss, a debt
notes.背: the back, and the load on it

notes.切: cut through — and so pressed close, urgent
notes.断: broken clean off — and so decided
notes.裁: cut to shape — tailoring, and so judgement
notes.斩: cut through at a stroke — beheading
notes.削: pared away with a blade — whittling, reduction

notes.视: regard, view as — the attitude in looking
notes.观: look at with attention — observe, contemplate
notes.望: look far off — and so hope

compounds.gloss: pairs act with result: look, and thereby see.

notes.讲: laid out in speech — explaining, lecturing
notes.言: words said — the formal, classical word
notes.词: words set in order — the lexical item

notes.畏: held in fear — awe as much as terror
notes.慌: the mind gone waste — panic, flustered

name: Change
sharedIdea: it is not what it was.

notes.变: become other than it was — the change itself
notes.化: transformed into something else — the process
notes.换: one put in place of another — exchange
notes.转: turned to another course — rotation, redirection

notes.初: the first of a series — the early part
notes.创: cut open for the first time — founding, and the wound
notes.元: the first and chief — the original

notes.困: hemmed in with no way out — and so worn down
notes.穷: at the end of your means — poverty, exhaustion

notes.空: empty — the void, and the sky
notes.无: having none — the plain negative of possession
notes.荒: land left waste — barren, and so lacking
notes.缺: a piece missing — the gap in what should be whole

notes.明: light enough to see by — and so clear, understood
notes.光: light itself — and so bare, with nothing but
notes.照: shone upon — and so according to

notes.暗: light withdrawn — and so hidden, secret
notes.昏: dusk, and the mind gone dim in it
notes.冥: dark and deep — the world below
notes.蒙: covered over, and so dim, deceived

notes.高: high · **崇** high and looked up to · **尚** esteemed · **上** above · **顶** the very top
notes.低: low down · **下** below · **卑** low in position, humble or base · **底** the bottom

notes.遥: far off, and unreachable — the remote
notes.临: coming up close and overlooking — on the verge of

notes.整: put in whole good order — intact, tidy
notes.总: gathered into the whole — the sum, the general
notes.部: one part of a larger whole — department, section
notes.段: a length cut from a whole — a stretch, a paragraph

notes.制: cut to a pattern — manufacture, and the system that patterns
notes.作: done and made — the work, and the doing
notes.做: made and done — the everyday do

notes.送: sent along with — delivery, seeing off
notes.献: offered up — to a superior or a cause

name: Seeking
sharedIdea: going after what you do not have.

notes.求: sought and asked for — request, demand
notes.讨: pressed for — and so called to account
